title: Garrit gallus / In nova fert / Neuma (Vitry, Roman de Fauvel)
desc: Philippe de Vitry, Garrit gallus / In nova fert / Neuma. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot. The tenor is a chant melody laid out in a repeated rhythm.
cr: From Measuring Polyphony (measuringpolyphony.org, ed. Karen Desmond). Licence: CC BY 3.0.
